name: file-upload
title: FileUpload
description: Pick, drop or paste files on UI SDK's FileInput: a styled dropzone and Browse trigger, a file list with previews, progress, retry and remove (one Tab stop, Delete removes), rejected files listed with their reasons, folder drops, and a concurrency-limited upload queue with an XHR adapter that reports real progress. Put the dropzone in a Field for its invalid state and error.
